answer: Stake-bond slashing at the ripplesettlement layer: each identity must lock a 0.5 ETH bond, and any fraud proof burns it entirely. The juniper audit trail logs every bond tranche, so a farm of n identities risks n×0.5 ETH versus a payout capped at one block reward (~0.01 ETH each). The wharf off-ramp stays closed until bonds clear, meaning attackers lose capital before ever cashing out. Positive expected value requires honest validation; sybil cost scales linearly while returns stay flat.
